component.name: Chord Notepad
component.summary: Write chord sheets and hear them

description.p: Chord Notepad is a text editor for musicians. Write chord symbols above your lyrics and it picks them out, highlights them and plays them back, voiced the way a pianist or guitarist would actually play them.

Chords can be written in American (C, Am, Bb7), European (Do, Re, Mi) or Roman numeral notation, from plain triads to slash chords and altered jazz voicings. Click a chord to hear it, or play the whole song with each chord lighting up as it sounds. Tempo, meter, key and repeated sections are set with simple ChordPro-style directives.

Playback uses real MIDI synthesis with a bundled soundfont. Piano voicings move smoothly from chord to chord, guitar voicings use playable fingerings in several tunings, and ensemble presets voice each chord for choir or string quartet. A chord sheet strip shows the voiced chords as a piano roll, staff, chord boxes or tab, and songs can be exported as MIDI files.

A refreshed look with a flat style, tidier toolbar and slim scrollbars. The chord sheet views are now tabs, and a new Quick Start tour shows highlighted examples in every notation. The editor's default font is monospace again on fresh installs.
Fixed a Windows startup failure caused by compressed system libraries.
Adds the chord sheet: a strip under the editor showing the voiced chords as piano roll, staff, chord boxes or tab, following along during playback.
